definitions.explanation: An outbreak of spots, redness, or irritation on the skin, typically caused by allergies, infections, or other medical conditions.

examples.japanese: {腕|うで}に{発疹|はっしん}が{出|で}た。
examples.english: A rash appeared on my arm.

examples.japanese: {薬|くすり}のアレルギーで{発疹|はっしん}が{出|で}ることがある。
examples.english: A rash can appear due to a drug allergy.

examples.japanese: {全身|ぜんしん}に{赤|あか}い{発疹|はっしん}が{広|ひろ}がったので、すぐに{病院|びょういん}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: Red rashes spread all over my body, so I went to the hospital immediately.

notes:
A medical term composed of {発|はつ} (outbreak, occurrence) and {疹|しん} (rash). The standard word for skin rashes in both medical and everyday contexts.

PRONUNCIATION:
The reading はっしん is standard. An older reading ほっしん also exists but is less common today. Be careful not to confuse with the homophone {発信|はっしん} (sending, transmitting).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {発疹|はっしん}が{出|で}る — a rash appears
- {発疹|はっしん}が{広|ひろ}がる — a rash spreads
- {発疹|はっしん}が{引|ひ}く — a rash subsides
- アレルギー{性|せい}{発疹|はっしん} — allergic rash

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {湿疹|しっしん} — eczema, dermatitis (chronic or recurring skin condition)
- {蕁麻疹|じんましん} — hives, urticaria (raised itchy welts)
- かぶれ — rash from contact irritation (more casual)
